case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A is built for that: a clear, bankable structure for the pump shaft on our new HX series, with the shortest lead time on the table.

Several bidders are competing for this award, and it goes to the best package. We cannot promise it in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, because it pairs the strongest payment terms with a price that reflects the following:

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy cost side:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

For your management, in plain words: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a firm unit price, a settled payment term and a defined lead time for a new series, which supports capacity planning on your side. Please take Option A to your decision-maker as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Hi, we checked the alloy index and the quality ppm you mentioned, and we can drop the price to €31.00. We really have to keep the lead time at 52 days though, because 35 days is just too tight for our production and would cost a lot more. We are fine with the 45 days payment from your Option C, so let's go with that!

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit under standard terms with a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. This offer stays valid for 30 days.
